items.title: Huge crowds greet Pope in Paris for open-air Mass
items.description: More than half a million people are expected to attend the event in the heart of the French capital.

items.title: Iran offers US deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
items.description: Asked about the Iranian proposal, a US official told the BBC "constructive discussions" were taking place through mediators.

items.title: British national among six dead in building explosion close to Acropolis in Athens
items.description: Four Americans and a Greek national are among those killed in a suspected gas explosion, officials said.

items.title: Bangkok roads submerged as flood disaster declared
items.description: An emergency has been declared across the capital of Thailand as days of heavy rain leave the city inundated.

items.title: South African white genocide does not exist, new ambassador to US tells BBC
items.description: Roelf Meyer tells the BBC that being a white Afrikaner gives him legitimacy to challenge Trump's claim of a genocide.

items.title: OpenAI bots meddled with multiple US government agency sites
items.description: OpenAI said its bots accessed public data from a range of institutions during test exercises.

items.title: Black woman found hanging from tree was dead before body was 'staged', police say
items.description: Tasia Fortune's body was found hanging from a tree on the grounds of an abandoned home in Jackson in August.
